h1: Custom Alpi Outdoor Blankets for Branding
metaTitle: Custom Alpi Outdoor Blankets | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Custom Alpi outdoor blankets for your brand. Durable, stylish, and perfect for events. Order bulk branded blankets at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Alpi outdoor blankets combine the durability of polyester with a soft, fleece-like feel that stands up to frequent use at picnics, concerts, and corporate outings. Whether you choose the sand-repellent Roll-Up Picnic Blanket or the plaid Fraser Fleece Blanket, each Alpi product offers easy roll-up storage and machine-washable care. These blankets are ideal for safety managers outfitting break rooms or marketing directors seeking a practical giveaway that keeps your logo visible season after season. Decorate with screen printing or embroidery for a polished finish.
heroAltText: Custom Alpi outdoor blanket with company logo, rolled up and tied, ready for giveaway
